text.en: Veronica's Ballistas and Reload
[Unique] [Initiation] Create 1 Ballista card(s). At the start of the turn, create 1 Ballista card(s).
[Unactivatable] [Ephemeral] [Ballista] 150% Extra Attack to a random enemy. At the end of the turn, proc.
When a Skill Card of a different Combatant is activated, 1 Reload.
[Unique] Increase max stack of Reload by 1. 2 Reload.

body.en:
Veronica's Main Gimmick is her Ballistas and Reload Stacks
Ballistas are Unique created cards with 0 cost, that Activate when turn is ended
Activating a Ballista makes an "Extra Attack" and Exhausts it
Ballista's "Extra Attacks" Can Crit
Ballista's "Extra Attacks" Can be affected by Elemental Weakness Now
Reload is how Veronica increases the damage of Ballistas
Every stack of Reload is 50% Multiplicative damage for Ballistas that turn
Max Reload Stacks is 3 base, 4 with Bombarment Prep and 5 with E4
Example:
150% Ballista with 2 Reload = 150% x 200% = 300% not 150% + 100% = 250%
Precision Aim and Eternal Hunger
